ops.text: Walk 12: each lot bed has a low rock rim to seaward and barnacle rubble beside its clams. Kelp or weed edges the far side (owner point: lot-bed composition).

ops.why: Lot one on the bed under the raft, where a diver works her family's lot: the quests' underwater livelihood.
The surface tender's raft over lot one, the boat that shows a passer-by where the place is.
The deep lot under the rowboat, where the divers stay down longest.

lootTable.storyNote: A deep-lot diver kept her best pearl out of the tally. She weighted the basket on the bed by the fourth lot to fetch it later. She drowned on the deep lots that season. The basket is still there.

cue.text: A human skull lies among the clams by the fourth lot's cairn. The basket rests on the bed a short swim west of it, 8 m down.

ops.why: The flat bed just west of the fourth and deepest lot, 8 m down past the drop-off: only a diver reaches it.
